_source: n8n OpenAPI spec v1.1.1 — workflowSettings schema
_note: All fields in the settings object on a workflow. This is the richest source of governance and dependency data.

saveExecutionProgress.description: Whether to save execution progress (intermediate results per node)

saveManualExecutions.description: Whether to save manually triggered executions

saveDataErrorExecution.description: Whether to save execution data on error. 'all' = keeps all data (potential data retention risk)

saveDataSuccessExecution.description: Whether to save execution data on success. 'all' = keeps all data

executionTimeout.description: Max execution time in seconds. 0 or unset = no timeout

errorWorkflow.description: ID of another workflow that handles errors for this one. KEY FIELD: creates deterministic connected-automations link.

callerPolicy.description: Controls which workflows can call this workflow via Execute Workflow node. 'any' = no restrictions. 'none' = completely blocked. 'workflowsFromSameOwner' (default) = only workflows from same project (for personal: same user; for team: same team project). 'workflowsFromAList' = only specific IDs listed in callerIds.
callerPolicy._expliq_insight: KEY FIELD for dependency graph. 'workflowsFromAList' + callerIds = explicit sub-workflow dependencies. 'workflowsFromSameOwner' means dependencies exist within the same project scope.

callerIds.description: Comma-separated workflow IDs allowed to call this workflow. Only used when callerPolicy = 'workflowsFromAList'.

timeSavedPerExecution.description: Estimated time saved per execution IN MINUTES. KEY FIELD: n8n's own ROI data. If set, combine with execution count: 'You estimated 5 min/run × 520 runs/wk = ~43 hrs/wk saved'.

availableInMCP.description: Controls whether this workflow is accessible via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). When enabled, AI assistants and MCP clients can discover and execute this workflow. Requirements: workflow must be active, must contain at least one active Webhook node. Security note: any MCP client with API credentials can execute it.
availableInMCP._expliq_insight: If a workflow is MCP-enabled, the company is actively exposing automations to AI tools. This is a maturity signal AND a security consideration. Expliq should flag MCP-exposed workflows.

continueOnFail.description: DEPRECATED — use onError instead. Legacy field: if true, workflow continues after a node fails. Still present in older workflows.
